generator: website_assets/web/convert.py (from website_assets/pino, export_for_web.py output of 2026-10-14); packed by site/scripts/quantize-vessel.mjs

units.s: mm along the vessel (geodesic distance from the inlet cap)

vessel_note: coronary branch label is not recorded in the CFD dataset

packing.note: uint16 quantized (value = offset + q * scale, per axis for positions), zigzag delta per component, planar bytes (low bytes then high bytes); vertices and triangles reordered along the inlet-outlet chord for locality, the surface itself is unchanged; normals are computed by the viewer; the speed arrays live in a second file (chunks.speed) fetched only when a speed-dependent field is chosen

p_err.note: not stored; the viewer computes it from the two decoded pressure arrays

ranges.note: no paper figure for this model: p range = this case's CFD surface pressure min/max (PINO spans a narrower range, keep the same limits for both); p_err_abs_max = 99th percentile of |p_err| (the error is asymmetric, the largest positive errors sit at the throat: use an above-range colour); vmag_max = wall vertices, vmag_cap_max = cap vertices, streamline_vmag_max = streamlines (99th percentiles)
viewer_notes: Pressure: paint p_cfd and p_pino with the same p range and always show the colourbar. PINO equals p_proximal_Pa from the inlet to s = 5.0 mm, spreads the stenotic drop over a longer stretch (smaller total drop, FFR 0.824 vs CFD 0.83) and is nearly flat over the last 6.4 mm; do not describe that flat stretch as pressure recovery.

Error: p_err = p_pino - p_cfd on a symmetric diverging range +/- p_err_abs_max (99th percentile); the error is asymmetric, so values above +p_err_abs_max (the throat) take a distinct above-range colour.

Surface speed: the wall is no-slip, so vmag on wall vertices is the speed of the first interior node (near-wall speed, mesh-spacing dependent); cap vertices carry the speed about 3 gate lengths inside the cap plane. Wall range 0..vmag_wall_max, caps 0..vmag_cap_max; to use one range, mask caps with region > 0. Streamlines are the better speed comparison.
Streamlines: colour vmag and vmag_pino both on 0..streamline_vmag_max.
FFR: read on the probe planes (geometry.ffr_probes), not at the curve ends; use metrics.case.ffr.

geometry.origin: bounding-box centre of the vessel surface (translation only)

ffr.note: read on the same two probe planes 5 mm inside each cap (geometry.ffr_probes): CFD over every plane node, PINO over the stored 512-node subsample of each plane; not at the curve ends

pino_profile.note: inlet_plateau_mm: PINO pressure equals p_proximal_Pa up to this s; distal_flat_mm: last stretch where the PINO section mean moves < 2% of its total drop (not pressure recovery)

percentile_in_cohort.note: percent of the 85 cases with a value <= this case (higher R2 = better, higher MAE/RMSE = worse)

cohort.source: current model, 10-fold CV (not a paper figure)
cohort.points: all volume nodes of each case; velocity = speed |u|

reference_pipeline.note: upper bound for the lab's CFD pipeline on the reference cluster; this case's own run time was not logged

cfd.note: wall_time_s is null because this case's own run was not logged (no run logs came with the dataset); reference_pipeline holds the owner's measured upper bound for the same CFD pipeline (mirrors site/src/data/content.ts cfdReference). mpi_ranks is the default of the provided run.sh; the rank count actually used was not recorded

pino.note: inference = encoder + decoder over every volume node (fp32, one GPU, median after warm-up); preprocessing = SDF grid and input assembly, about 1-2 s depending on caches

model.name: PINO: geometry-informed neural operator (GINO backbone) with a pressure-only Navier-Stokes residual at the prescribed and at counterfactual inlet flows
model.protocol: 10-fold cross-validation over 85 patients; this case is predicted by the fold model that never saw it

selection.note: A well-predicted case, not a typical one: pressure R2 0.963 ranks 13/85 (1 = best) and speed R2 0.846 ranks 16/85 against cohort medians of 0.898 and 0.756. Show the cohort median beside the case numbers.
selection.rule: picked by hand for a natural-looking vessel (smooth calibre, no abrupt diameter step) among clean-label cases with good prediction (pressure R2 >= 0.92, speed R2 >= 0.75, |FFR error| <= 0.03, CFD FFR <= 0.90); a well-predicted case, not a typical one: see dataset_metrics for the cohort medians

percentile_in_cohort.note: percent of the 85 cases with a value <= this case (higher R2 = better, higher MAE/RMSE = worse)

thinning.rule: every stride-th point per line, first and last point of every line kept, every line kept

vmag_pino.source: PINO speed interpolated at the same CFD streamline points
